The factual matrix of case:-
On 25.03.2010 at about 8.20am BMTC traffic inspector CW.1 has stopped the BMTC Bus bg.No.KA-01-F-3808 at the bus shelter of Maharani's college, within the territorial limits of High Grounds Police Sta- Crl.A.No.84/2022 tion.

At that time, CW.1 being the Traffic Inspector of BMTC by name Sanjeev Kumar, CW.2 BMTC Traffic In- spector Taju Sab Maltaf and CW.3 Assistant Traffic In- spector of BMTC were checking the tickets of passen- gers who were travelling in the aforesaid bus.
At that time, they have found that the accused is travelling in the said bus by using forged bus pass and cheated the BMTC.
Accordingly, accused is charge sheeted.
3. In this regard, CW.1 lodged complaint before CW8 Police Sub Inspector Jagadish and also produced ac- cused before him at 9.00pm on 25.03.2010 along with fake bus pass and ID card.
Based on the complaint lodged by the CW.1 FIR has been registered against the accused in Cr.No.75/2010.
Thereafter, he has ar- rested the accused interrogated.
Thereafter, he has pro- Crl.A.No.84/2022 duced the accused before the jurisdictional magistrate.
Thereafter, he has rushed to the spot and conducted SO mahazar.
Thereafter, he has seized the disputed bus pass by drawing mahazar at 9.00pm on 25.03.2010.
On 26.03.2010 CW8 rushed to the spot and conducted SO mahazar in the presence of wit- nesses.
Further interrogated and recorded their state- ment.
4. On 8.4.2010 IO submitted requisition to the Assis- tant Traffic Inspector of BMTC.

Based on that,
he has submitted information regarding issuance of Buspass, ID Card on 04.52010.
Thereafter he has interrogated and recorded their statement of Smt.Geetha.

After com- pleting other formalities,
he has submitted charge sheet Crl.A.No.84/2022 against the accused person.
During investigation learned Trial court enlarged the accused No.1 on bail.
5. On considering the charge and other material the learned Trial Court took cognizance and ordered for reg- ister the case against the accused in Register-III and is- sued summons to accused.
6. In pursuant summons, accused appeared before the trial court.
Charge sheet and other materials are sup- plied to the accused.
Charge has been framed and read- over to him.
Accused pleaded not guilty, claims to be tried.
Hence, case is posted for evidence.
7. In order to prove the guilt of the accused persons the prosecution has examined this witness as PW1 to Crl.A.No.84/2022 PW.6 and six documents are got marked as Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.6.

Thereafter,
statement of the accused is recorded U/s.313 of Cr.P.C.
Accused denied the in- criminating evidence but he has not chosen to lead evi- dence.

Further, after hearing both side, the learned trial court has Nadeem Pasha vs High Grounds P.S on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22683860/
2 convicted the accused for the alleged offence punishable U/s.420 of IPC by passing impugned Judg- ment and order.

sentences.text: The appellant disagreed and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and order passed by the Trial Court, appellant has preferred this appeal on the ground that all witness examined by the prosecution are related to the police witness and relating to BMTC.
There is no scientific evidence regarding fabrication of MO-1 & MO-2.
There is no specific allegations that how Crl.A.No.84/2022 many passengers were travelling in the bus.
The IO has not recorded the statement of co-passengers who were travelling in the said bus.
Ingredients of section 415 of IPC does not attracts to the case on hand.
The prosecution utterly failed to prove the guilt of the ac- cused persons beyond reasonable doubt.

9. The appellant has taken specific contention that as on the alleged date of incident, there were passen- gers in the bus and the bus conductor was talking with the passengers in singular language which lead to com- motion, as accused interfered in the said commotion, for this reason, false case has been registered against the accused.
The prosecution not proved the guilt of the accused persons beyond reasonable doubt.
Hence, prays for allow the appeal and set aside the impugned Crl.A.No.84/2022 Judgment and order passed by the trial court and ac- quit the accused from the alleged offence.

10. The learned counsel for the accused submitted that the incident has occurred in the public place,
there is no independent witness to the alleged incident.
PW.1 PW.2 and PW.5 are staff members of the BMTC.
They have deposed in support and in the interest of their de- partment.
There is no documents how MO-1 and MO-2 are fabricated one.
IO has not collected the duty certifi- cate of the PW1, PW2 and PW5.
IO has not collected the document regarding MO-1 & MO-2 are forged one.
The trial court wrongly considered the MO-1 & MO-2 are fabricated one.
The learned counsel for the accused strongly relied on section 415 of IPC.
The reasons as- Crl.A.No.84/2022 signed by the trial court is not correct and proper.
The prosecution utterly failed to prove the guilt of the ac- cused persons beyond reasonable doubt.
Hence, prays for allow the appeal and acquit the accused by setting aside the impugned Judgment and Order.

11. As against this, the learned PP submitted that in this case, PW1, PW2 and PW5 are eye witnesses who have obtained the ticket, conduct the checking verified the tickets as well as the pass issued by the BMTC.
Therefore, they are natural witness and eye witnesses to the alleged incident.
There is no reasons for discard their evidence.
On prima-facie itself it discloses that MO-1 & MO-2 are fabricated one and same are used for cheating the Government as well as the Bengaluru Met- Crl.A.No.84/2022 ropolitan Transport Corporation.

Whether the impugned Judgment and order of the Trial Court is perverse,
Arbitrary and capricious.?

He has categorically stated that he is working as Assistant Traffic Inspector of Vigilance Wing Crl.A.No.84/2022 of BMTC.
On the date of the alleged incident he has checked and verified the passengers tickets, MO-1 & MO-2 which were in the possession of the accused.
He found that in the ID there was variations in its Serial Number, Emblem of the Department was xeroxed then, they have confirmed that the accused was using fake bus pass and ID Card.
In this regard, he has lodged complaint Ex.P.1.
Next day police came to the spot and conducted SO mahazar Ex.P.2.

Further, he also identified the fake bus pass and fake ID Card which are marked at MO-1 & MO-2.
17.

Xerox pass can be easily identified by the bus conductor in usual Crl.A.No.84/2022 course.
Further, he admitted that, he has not verified whether he demanded the original bus pass from the accused.
He has not obtained the signature of accused on MO-1 & MO-2.
Further, same are not examined through scientific method whether to find out the bus pass is fake or not.
Further, he stated that he has put his short sign on the complaint and mahazar.
The learned counsel for the accused denied regarding he was on duty on the date of the alleged incident.
This suggestions is denied.
Further, he is unable to speak about the clothes worn by the accused as on the date of incident.
The learned counsel for the accused suggested that in order to protect the omission on part of conductor you have lodged false complaint against the accused.
This suggestions is denied.

On prima- facie it clearly discloses that the accused was using fabricated MO-1 & MO-2 while travelling in the bus as on the date of the alleged incident.
31. PW1 and PW2 categorically stated that it is primary duty of the conductor to verify all bus pass are original one or not.

Immediately, after receipt of MO-1 & MO-2 from the custody of the accused,
they have questioned, verified from PW3.
PW3 stated in cross- examination stated that during interrogation, police questioned regarding why you are have not verified the fake pass.
Further, PW1 stated that, they have issued notice to PW3 regarding commission of mistake on his part at the time of his duty regarding verification of the MO-1 & MO-2 is original or fake one.

On considering Crl.A.No.84/2022 oral evidence of PW.1, PW.2, PW.4 and PW.5 Accused admitted that he was travelling in BMTC BUS bgKA- 01/F-3808 at Maharani's College bus shelter at about 8.20pm on 25.3.2010.
In this case, prosecution has successfuly proved that MO-1 and MO-2 are recovered from possession of the accused.
Further, accused took specific contention that he was purchased the ticket from Bus conductor and he travelled beyond his destination.
Further, he taken another contention that Bus conductor was conversation with him in singular langauge.

The prosecution has proved two things before Court that, accused was travelled in KA-01/F-3808 at Maharani's College bus shelter at about 8.20pm on 25.3.2010 with having MO-1 and MO-2. MO-2 contend photos of accused thereon.

Now onus of proof shifted Crl.A.No.84/2022 on accused has to prove two fact which are within in his knowledge, Firstly,
where is ticket purchased by him and why his photos found on MO-2 as contemplated U/Sec 108 of BSA-2023.
The accused has not discharged onus of proof lies on him.
By considering all these aspects, I am of the opinion that the prosecution successfully proved the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.

The accused is found that he was travelling in the said BMTC bus with having fake and fabricated bus pass and ID Card/MO-1 and MO-2.

The law not permitted to either of parties to criminal proceedings, have not right or power to move or file the application to alteration of charge.
